title: A new hobby
instructions: Wpisz w każdą lukę dokładnie jedno słowo. Skróty typu don't nie są poprawną odpowiedzią. Każda luka to 1 punkt.
text: My cousin has always enjoyed taking photographs, but it was only last year {{1}} he decided to turn his hobby into something more serious. He bought a second-hand camera and started attending a course at the local cultural centre. {{2}} first he found it difficult to understand how the settings work, but his teacher was patient and explained everything {{3}} the end of the lesson. Now he spends almost every weekend outside, looking {{4}} interesting subjects. He says that photography has taught him to notice details that he would never have seen otherwise. Last month his picture of an old bridge was published in a local magazine, {{5}} made him extremely proud. Although he does not earn any money yet, he hopes {{6}} be able to work as a professional photographer one day. In the meantime, he is saving up for a better lens. His advice to anyone {{7}} wants to try is simple: do not wait for the perfect equipment, but start {{8}} what you have.
